subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
title: Grade 1 English Language Arts: Word Reading, Fluency & Retelling
overview: Grade 1 English Language Arts immerses students in literary and informational texts, developing close reading comprehension, evidence-based writing, academic vocabulary, and collaborative discourse.
competencies: Read grade-level literary and informational texts with fluency, accuracy, and deep comprehension.
Cite specific textual evidence to substantiate answers, inferences, and central theme analyses.
Write clear, organized opinion, informative, and narrative compositions using standard grammar conventions.
Participate actively in collaborative discussions, expressing ideas clearly and building upon others' contributions.

modules.title: Phonics, Digraphs & Decoding Fluency
modules.description: Mastering consonant digraphs (sh, ch, th, wh), consonant blends, and short/long vowel sound patterns.

topics.title: Consonant Digraphs & Word Families
topics.description: Blending and spelling words with initial and final consonant digraphs.

topics.title: Silent E & Long Vowel Spelled with CVCe
topics.description: Recognizing the change from short vowels to long vowels when final e is added.

topics.title: Oral Reading Fluency & Prosody
topics.description: Reading grade-level texts with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression.

modules.title: Story Structure, Central Message & Character Voice
modules.description: Analyzing narrative stories, identifying lessons/morals, and describing how illustrations enhance text meaning.

topics.title: Key Details & Story Retelling
topics.description: Retelling stories including characters, settings, and main plot milestones.

topics.title: Central Message & Moral of the Story
topics.description: Identifying what characters learn through their mistakes and decisions.

modules.title: Informational Text Features & Structured Paragraph Writing
modules.description: Using headings, glossaries, and diagrams to learn facts, and writing organized informative and opinion paragraphs.

topics.title: Navigating Nonfiction Text Features
topics.description: Using table of contents, bold words, and captions to locate key facts.

topics.title: Writing Opinion & Informative Sentences
topics.description: Stating a topic or opinion, providing reasons, and writing concluding thoughts.
